entries.title: Separate governed roles
entries.summary: Research, debugging, knowledge, automation, implementation, and visual acceptance use bounded authorities; no implementer certifies its own change.

entries.title: Local-first knowledge before vector infrastructure
entries.summary: Repository Markdown and existing SQLite FTS5 are primary. QMD is blocked on this Windows host and hosted vector stores are deferred.

entries.title: DuckDuckGo is the primary free search option
entries.summary: Select the keyless DuckDuckGo skill rather than operating an unapproved SearXNG deployment; the ddgs CLI remains an explicit provisioning prerequisite.

entries.title: No implicit watcher activation
entries.summary: Watcher definitions remain disabled until an operator supplies an explicit target, schedule, delivery, and approval.

entries.title: Do not repair the known projection defect in this revamp
entries.summary: The first governed visual run must expose and block the existing comp/visual projection mismatch rather than fixing it.
